entries.blurb: Managing multiple local repositories often means losing track of work-in-progress across branches, with no lightweight way to plan tasks alongside the code itself. GitGrove, a multi-repo git manager, added a branch-scoped Taskboard for creating, editing, and tracking work items and their sub-tasks against a repo's branches with full CRUD support. Built out a Vitest test suite covering the new components and Zustand stores to keep the growing frontend verified.
